newsitem.title: USA: Northrop comfortable with '97 EPS estimates.
newsitem.headline: Northrop comfortable with '97 EPS estimates.

text.p: Northrop Grumman, Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer Kent Kresa said Friday he is comfortable with earnings per share estimates for fiscal 1997 "on the order of $5.80."

Kresa said in a statement that sales for 1997 will be about $8.4 billion, keeping the company on track for its target on growing sales from about $8 billion in fiscal 1996 to about $10 billion by the year 2000.
Shares of the defense electronics and aerostructure contractor were 3/8 higher at 78-3/8 in late morning trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
